macros.name: lctt
macros.doc: The macro \lctt prints its argument in light-condensed weight, monospaced mode, and uses a slanted font if italic shape is in force.

macros.name: monott
macros.doc: The package defines two macros, \proptt and \monott that allow you to use proportional typewriter mode or monospace typewriter mode whether or not you selected the proportional option.

macros.name: proptt
macros.doc: The package defines two macros, \proptt and \monott that allow you to use proportional typewriter mode or monospace typewriter mode whether or not you selected the proportional option.
